targets.title: Politicizing the COVID-19 Pandemic: Ideological Differences in Adherence to Social Distancing.
targets.evidence_quote:
Claim summary​: We selected Hypothesis 1 from Rothgeber et al: More conservative
participants would be less likely to follow social distancing guidelines.
targets.outcome_computational_quote:
Thus, by making some assumptions about the original authors’ decisions--not clearly
reported in the manuscript--we were able to reproduce the exact statistic for the results of
the linear regression, and the bivariate correlation.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
While these results support the hypothesis that social distancing is inversely related to
political conservatism, we were not able to reproduce the exact statistics with our
pre-registered analyses.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The focal statistics were recovered after reconstructing exclusions, covariates and transformations. The initially preregistered alternative analyses also support the same substantive hypothesis. Incidental descriptive-statistic errors do not change the focal finding.
